heading: FAQ’s on Food Delivery App Development Solutions

items.question: Can you customise the app to our business model?
items.answer: Yes. The solution is white label and can be adapted to single-restaurant, multi-restaurant or cloud-kitchen models.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation and extra features.

items.question: How much does a food delivery app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on the apps, features and integrations you need. Share your requirements for a clear estimate.

items.question: Do you build the restaurant and rider apps too?
items.answer: Yes. Customer, restaurant and rider apps are built together with a common admin panel.

items.question: Can customers track orders live?
items.answer: Yes. Real-time tracking and status notifications are part of the core solution.

items.question: Can I integrate my preferred payment gateway?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate local and international gateways based on your market.
